scope: Read-only production integration assessment with source snapshots and reused prior native/component inference receipts. No RTL changes or new simulation/compiler run.

next_missing_input.required_proof: Actual CPU-side driver/equation, polarity and transitions through CPU-board continuations into the video-board RAM-disable input.
next_missing_input.why_constant_not_enough: Joined constant1 enables all CPU slots; it does not establish dynamic bus applicability or grant transitions relative to RAS/CAS.
next_missing_input.missing_coordinates: CPU-side Bandido continuation turn near(3555,5210), aligned risers around4215/4250; retained alternate source still did not prove driver bridge.

minimal_wiring.supported: Existing interfaces and joined DO→readback→READY proof.
minimal_wiring.production_change: n8080_cpu_ready .ready(service.ready); preserve INTA/I/O priority and replace only RAM DIN with captured_data.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: Raw CPU_WR_RD source and non-fixture IRQ/I/O applicability.

minimal_wiring.supported: Mapped CPU address, raw WR, SYNC/STSTB, WE and RAS/CAS/DO event semantics.
minimal_wiring.production_change: Instantiate control/storage/readback; replace abstract RAM write_start commit by actual pin events.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: CPU_WR_RD waveform and absolute phase/reset alignment.

minimal_wiring.production_change: Dynamic physical Hbyte/V to control; held video DO to qualified byte capture/serializer/pixel deadline.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: Dynamic H/V origin/flip, row setup and video capture ordering; fixed fixture did not cover this.

minimal_wiring.supported: Master clock plus independently identified crystal enable is the required interface.
minimal_wiring.production_change: Define a periodic physical phase enable unaffected by CPU execution pause; specify debug_freeze separately.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: Joined CPU-derived enable is constant0/1 during pause, not a periodic20.16MHz enable.

minimal_wiring.supported: Existing paused ownership, address mask and configurable timed interface.
minimal_wiring.production_change: Explicit service bridge with bounded read/write deadlines, video priority and CPU captured-byte restoration.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: No ACK/valid input, two-clock tail not proven for pin-event readback, same-address collisions unqualified.

minimal_wiring.supported: Separate ROM/audio/PROM loads and warm RAM retention.
minimal_wiring.production_change: Keep download routes; define cold-zero initialization, control cancellation and phase/refresh policy.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: Uninitialized storage differs from production zero startup; source reset/refresh alignment open.

minimal_wiring.supported: M10K logical serialization/resource result; native conditional CPU service.
minimal_wiring.production_change: Add four component files through QIP only after integration inputs/policies are settled.
minimal_wiring.blocked_by: Changed full-board graphics/CPU/persistence/pause/IRQ and device fit/timing acceptance are not covered by component proof.

pause_enable_hazard.effect_high: Slots advance on every master edge.

read_during_write_collision: Current simulation nonblocking RAM reads observe old state at an overlapping write; new source-scheduled sampling and video/debug same-byte behavior require explicit ownership and capture qualification.
uncovered_semantics: CPU_WR_RD dynamic generator/polarity and edge timing.
Physical H/V changes, flip/origin, row setup and serializer capture.
Pause/debug/service ownership, current CPU-phase-derived enable hazard, timed hiscore latency and readback restoration.
Deterministic cold RAM initialization versus warm retention; phase/reset/refresh during download/pause.
IRQ/IN/OUT boundaries and real whole-board ROM delivery with physical RAM service.
